The researcher confirmed that P1-P11 represent eleven distinct human practitioners who completed the revised survey; confidential contact mapping is retained outside the public research repository.
Only anonymised participant codes, professional roles, experience, dates, consent, and questionnaire responses are retained in this workbook.
Eleven consented submissions were received between 2026-08-22 and 2026-08-26.
Include a submission only when consent is present and all ten SUS items contain a valid response from 1 to 5.
P9 was excluded because Question 3 was blank. No answer was imputed or reconstructed.
Ten complete responses: five DevOps/DevSecOps and five SRE practitioners.
Odd-numbered items: response minus 1. Even-numbered items: 5 minus response. Sum the ten adjusted contributions and multiply by 2.5 to obtain a score from 0 to 100.
Descriptive statistics only: completion rate, mean, median, sample standard deviation, minimum, maximum, role-group counts, role-group means, and raw item means.
The source workbook's Score column contains form-quiz zeros and is not a SUS score; it is excluded from every calculation.

The result describes perceived usability in this small convenience sample. It does not establish population-level usability, production effectiveness, workload reduction, diagnostic accuracy, or causal impact.
The export does not retain task-by-task completion, timing, error, assistance, or free-text interview records; those outcomes are not claimed.
